stationQuestionAspects.specificUnavailableOrMissingCaptureReaso: Missing fresh sensor records, excursion/quarantine state, exact lot-bound authorized disposition or an actual release log prevents an evaluated cold-chain result.
Missing explicit jurisdiction/trigger policy or an attributed event-bound report receipt prevents an evaluated clinical reporting result. No statutory deadline is inferred.

Missing current participant-bound protocol/consent versions or an attributed signed correction chain prevents an evaluated trial-state result. This supplies no EHR integration or complete legal consent-form assessment.
Missing complete independently derived affected-lot genealogy or actual delivery capture prevents an evaluated recall result. A graph closure alone is not recall delivery.
Missing effective boundary version, configured fuel limit or verified voyage-bound exception authority prevents an evaluated fuel-use result. No MARPOL threshold or ECA is inferred.
